LEC.text: His last lap in Q3 (started 14:50:44) was not completed. His car slowed to 0 km/h 28 s into the lap (at 14:51:12), after braking hard from 340 km/h, and it did not move again during the lap window: it stopped on track. A red flag was shown at 14:51:30, 18 s after it stopped. The data does not say why (a crash and a mechanical failure look the same in it).
